Description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role Summary And Impact As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC) , you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive BI who will: As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. The Sr. Data Engineer is responsible for the design and build of cloud-based data solutions, working with other team members to manage the development and maintenance of business intelligence and data quality compliance tools. Reporting to the Assoc. Director based in the US, you will provide overviews of project status, progression, and roadblocks. We are looking for a Sr. Data Engineer who will: Work closely with a team of data engineers, developers and UX designers to create our data pipeline and workflows to support our media performance reporting, managing the design, build and maintenance phases of client reporting projects. Work with Business Intelligence/Data Operations to define and document reporting/visualization requirements, ensuring data quality and providing ongoing support and maintenance for existing workspaces. Deploy new client teams to the cloud data solutions, providing guidance and support throughout the onboarding process. Define QA guidelines and automate the current QA process, and—with support from the Assoc. Director—develop tools, processes, and best practices to achieve workflow efficiencies and drive value for client teams and clients. Act as the subject matter expert for questions/projects relating to data quality, BI tools, and business rules, ensuring that best practices are being followed amongst all projects. Facilitate communication and progression of tasks through regular status meetings and working sessions; proactively elevate and resolve project roadblocks; and build positive relationships with internal teams by effectively communicating roles, responsibilities, and expectations. Skills And Experience If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have: Bachelor's or advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Math, Computer Science, or Sciences (preferred). A minimum of three to four years’ experience, including 2-3 years in data governance processes within a data warehousing, ETL and business intelligence environment. Experience with the full development life cycle of an application or reporting solution—from design through test and deployment. Experience in media (digital investment, analytics, or ad operations) and understanding of processes across multiple media channels (digital, search, social, offline, etc.), handling diverse datasets (paid media, owned, etc.). Advanced knowledge of databases and data warehouses such as SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Snowflake, etc., and one or more programming languages (e.g., Python). Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, GCP, AWS) and data engineering platforms (e.g., Databricks). Familiarity with business intelligence tools (Tableau, PowerBI) and project/product management tools (Jira, Confluence, Smartsheets, Azure DevOps/VSTS). Experience with advertising campaign management/buying platforms such as Sizmek, GCM, Flashtalking, Moat, DV, IAS, Mediaocean, Nielsen, ComScore, Facebook, YouTube, Google Ads, SA360, DV360, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, etc. Exceptional organizational skills, multi-tasking capabilities, strong attention to detail, and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
